articles.summary: We’re in the jQuery age of AI agents, where every integration feels like duct tape, and standards are still a dream. Just like jQuery once smoothed over the chaos of incompatible browsers, MCP is doing the same for fragmented AI tools, making it finally possible to ship agents that actually work. It’s not perfect, but it’s the layer we need right now.
articles.title: The jQuery Age of AI Agents
